title: The vignette m4 tie law: two units with a latent tie
attribution: Synthetic teaching data and results from the postrank 1.1.0 R package (JoonHo Lee; package code MIT). Site data licence CC BY 4.0.
change_notice: Rebuilt with the vignette's constructor and evaluated with postrank 1.1.0 (postrank_tie_pairwise, postrank_tie_evaluate); weak-loss risks computed from the listed law; numbers with 15 significant digits.
notice: Synthetic: no real units, observations or fitted models. Data licence CC BY 4.0.

facts.description: B is 1; A is 0, 1, or 2 with masses 1/10, 4/10, 5/10 (a complete finite law, not a sample).
facts.loss: Weak loss counts an equal pair as wrong; equality-neutral loss counts it as neither (risk = (E_w + tau (T - D)) / M, R0 = tau T / M).
